title: CoffeeTracking
description: Presentational props for the Acaia coffee-tracking screen: the wire shape of CoffeeTrackingProps (Sources/LifegamesComponentsCore/Coffee/CoffeeTrackingProps.swift). Only the stored properties are encoded; the derived values (consumedGrams, fillPercent, caffeineMgThisCup, isLinkLostMidSession, isPresenceUnknown, isSipping, primaryAction) are computed and never appear on the wire. Fixture pool for coffee-tracking previews (S98).

connection.title: CoffeeScaleConnection
connection.description: Scale link state. Raw values of CoffeeTrackingProps.ScaleConnection.

errorMessage.description: Non-nil only when connection is error.

batteryPercent.description: Scale battery level. Null when unknown or the scale is unpaired.

isSessionActive.description: True while a cup is actively tracked.

isCupOnScale.description: False while the cup is lifted. Meaningful only while connection is connected.

startWeightGrams.description: Baseline captured at New Cup (the full-cup weight).

lastStableWeightGrams.description: Last settled reading. Drives the fill meter.

currentWeightGrams.description: Instantaneous reading. May be about 0 while the cup is lifted.

flowRateGramsPerSec.description: Weight change per second, derived client-side. 0 when idle.

dailyTargetMg.description: Daily caffeine target. The Swift initializer defaults it to 400 mg (FDA guideline); the wire carries it explicitly.

beverage.title: CoffeeBeverage
beverage.description: Beverage type. Raw values of CoffeeTrackingProps.Beverage.
